subject: Sanaa na Michezo

activities.specific_competence: 1.1 Mastering the basics of singing and acting
activities.learning_activity: (a) Imitating sounds of living and non-living things
suggested_methods: Think-Write-Pair-Share: Guide pupils to imitate sounds of living and non-living things by thinking, writing names of the things, pairing and sharing
Improvisation and Performance: Organize pupils into learning groups to act out short events in order to demonstrate skills of using the body, voice, and imagination in their environment
Peer learning: Guide pupils in groups to prepare and present a play
activities.assessment_criteria: Skills of imitating sounds of living and non-living things have been correctly identified
suggested_resources: Audio recordings of living and non-living things
costumes and scripts of plays related to imitating sounds of living and non-living things

activities.specific_competence: 1.1 Mastering the basics of singing and acting
activities.learning_activity: (b) Singing in unison while observing proper posture and breathing
suggested_methods: Story songs: Guide pupils to sing songs derived from stories
Role play: Guide pupils to demonstrate actions that help to control breath during singing
Peer learning: Guide pupils to sing songs they like to one another
activities.assessment_criteria: Unison singing while observing proper posture and breathing has been correctly done

activities.specific_competence: 1.1 Mastering the basics of singing and acting
activities.learning_activity: (c) Using musical instruments found in their environment to accompany short songs
suggested_methods: Inquiry: Create an environment for pupils to touch and experiment with various musical instruments on their own
Demonstration: Guide pupils to use musical instruments found in their environment to accompany short songs
activities.assessment_criteria: Musical instruments found in their environment have been correctly used to accompany short songs
suggested_resources: songs recorded using various musical instruments
musical instruments available in the environment

activities.learning_activity: (a) Drawing simple pictures using a pencil and shading using a pencil
suggested_methods: Questions and Answers: Guide pupils to name simple shapes
Project work: Guide pupils in groups to draw pictures that express feelings
activities.assessment_criteria: Drawing pictures using a pencil has been correctly done
suggested_resources: Sample pictures drawn using a pencil
texts and shapes of various objects with descriptions on how to draw using a pencil

activities.learning_activity: Modelling simple shapes
suggested_methods: Demonstration: Practically guide pupils through the steps of modelling simple shapes
Project work: Guide pupils in groups to model simple shapes
activities.assessment_criteria: Various shapes have been correctly modelled
suggested_resources: liquid glue and various texts related to modelling

activities.learning_activity: Performing agility and balance exercises
suggested_methods: Demonstration: Show pupils the steps for performing agility and balance exercises
Guide pupils to perform agility and balance exercises
activities.assessment_criteria: Agility and balance exercises have been correctly performed

activities.learning_activity: Playing rede, running with a bottle on the head, and running with a spoon
suggested_methods: Structured exercises: Guide pupils to play games of running with a bottle on the head and running with a spoon
activities.assessment_criteria: The games of rede, running with a bottle on the head, and running with a spoon have been correctly played

activities.main_competence: 3.0 Mastering skills of exhibiting works of art and sports
activities.specific_competence: 3.1 Participating in exhibitions of works of art and sports
activities.learning_activity: (a) Exhibiting works of art at the class level
suggested_methods: Project work: Guide pupils in groups to participate in exhibitions of works of art
activities.assessment_criteria: Exhibitions of works of art have been correctly conducted

activities.main_competence: 3.0 Mastering skills of exhibiting works of art and sports
activities.specific_competence: 3.1 Participating in exhibitions of works of art and sports
activities.learning_activity: (b) Participating in sports competitions at the class level
suggested_methods: Project work: Guide pupils in groups to participate in sports competitions
activities.assessment_criteria: Sports competitions have been correctly conducted

activities.specific_competence: 1.1 Mastering the basics of singing and acting
activities.learning_activity: (a) Performing various body exercises by acting as living and non-living things
suggested_methods: Demonstration: Show students the steps of performing various body exercises by acting as living and non-living things

Role play: Guide students in thinking and creating mental images of various living and non-living things in their environment, and then acting out their sounds and actions in front of their fellow students
activities.assessment_criteria: Various body exercises by acting as living and non-living things have been performed correctly

activities.specific_competence: 1.1 Mastering the basics of singing and acting
activities.learning_activity: (b) Singing in unison and two-part harmony observing diction and tone
suggested_methods: Imitation: Guide students to imitate how to sing by observing diction and tone
Song composition: Guide students to sing call-and-response or greeting songs to each other
Storytelling: Involve students in narratives that use various songs while observing diction and tone
Role play: Involve students in singing various character songs while observing diction and tone
activities.assessment_criteria: Singing in unison and two-part harmony observing diction and tone has been performed correctly

activities.specific_competence: 1.1 Mastering the basics of singing and acting
activities.learning_activity: (c) Using musical instruments available in their environment to accompany the school song
suggested_methods: Inquiry: Prepare an environment for students to play musical instruments of their choice
Peer learning: Encourage students to learn from one another how to play musical instruments to accompany the school song
activities.assessment_criteria: Musical instruments have been used correctly to accompany the school song
suggested_resources: School song text and musical instruments

activities.learning_activity: Drawing pictures of various objects using a pencil
suggested_methods: Demonstration: Practically guide students through the steps of drawing pictures using a pencil
Project work: Guide students in groups to draw pictures using a pencil
activities.assessment_criteria: Pictures have been drawn correctly using a pencil
suggested_resources: various types of pencils and various texts related to picture drawing

activities.learning_activity: Modelling a model of a real object
suggested_methods: Demonstration: Practically guide students through the steps of modelling a model of a real object
Project work: Guide students in groups to model a model of a real object
activities.assessment_criteria: Models of real objects have been modelled correctly
suggested_resources: liquid glue and various texts related to pottery and modelling

activities.learning_activity: Performing exercises to build limb coordination and flexibility
suggested_methods: Structured exercises: Guide students to perform exercises that build limb coordination and flexibility
activities.assessment_criteria: Exercises to build limb coordination and flexibility have been performed correctly
suggested_resources: Exercise equipment (Balance pad, balance discs, balance boards and mat)

activities.learning_activity: Sack racing and chasing a chicken
suggested_methods: Structured exercises: Guide students to do sack racing and chasing a chicken
activities.assessment_criteria: Sack racing and chasing a chicken games have been played correctly

activities.learning_activity: Performing acrobatics
suggested_methods: Structured exercises: Guide students to perform acrobatics
activities.assessment_criteria: Acrobatic games have been played correctly
suggested_resources: Acrobatic equipment (mat, mattress, spring floor and carpet)

activities.main_competence: 3.0 Mastering skills in exhibiting works of art and sports
activities.specific_competence: 3.1 Participating in exhibitions of works of art and sports
activities.learning_activity: (a) Conducting art exhibitions at the school level
suggested_methods: Exhibition: Guide students to conduct art exhibitions at school
activities.assessment_criteria: Exhibitions of works of art have been conducted correctly

activities.main_competence: 3.0 Mastering skills in exhibiting works of art and sports
activities.specific_competence: 3.1 Participating in exhibitions of works of art and sports
activities.learning_activity: (b) Participating in sports competitions at the school level
suggested_methods: Project work: Guide students in groups to participate in sports competitions at school
activities.assessment_criteria: Sports competitions have been conducted correctly

activities.specific_competence: 1.1 Mastering the basics of singing and acting
activities.learning_activity: Acting using actions and voice, and actions without voice (mime)
suggested_methods: Demonstration: Guide students in groups to act using actions and voice
Mime and pantomime: Guide students in acting out the actions of living and non-living things using actions without voice (mime) accompanied by music
activities.assessment_criteria: Characteristics of living and non-living things have been accurately acted out using actions and voice, and actions without voice

activities.specific_competence: 1.1 Mastering the basics of singing and acting
activities.learning_activity: Singing while observing music dynamics and voice balancing
suggested_methods: Imitation: Guide students to imitate how to sing while observing music dynamics and voice balancing
Observation: Provide students with opportunities to watch videos and listen to audio of various choirs and groups singing while observing dynamics and voice balancing
Project work: Guide students to sing songs in at least two parts
Storytelling: Involve students in narratives that use various songs while paying attention to pronunciation and tone
Role play: Involve students in singing various character songs while paying attention to pronunciation and tone
activities.assessment_criteria: Music dynamics and voice balancing have been observed in singing
suggested_resources: Tanzanian patriotic songs and musical instruments

activities.specific_competence: 1.1 Mastering the basics of singing and acting
activities.learning_activity: Using musical instruments to accompany the singing of solfege (d r m f s l t d’)
suggested_methods: Observation: Provide students with opportunities to watch videos and listen to audio of various groups skillfully playing instruments to accompany solfege singing
Peer learning: Mix students with different abilities and encourage them to teach each other how to play musical instruments
Imitation: Guide students in playing musical instruments following musical scales
activities.assessment_criteria: Musical instruments have been used correctly to accompany the singing of solfege (d r m f s l t d’)

activities.learning_activity: Drawing pictures showing feelings and moods using a pencil
suggested_methods: Brainstorming: Guide students to identify tools and objects for drawing pictures of various items
Demonstration: Guide students to show the correct way of using tools in drawing pictures of various items
Demonstration: Guide students in the selection and correct use of tools for drawing various pictures
Exhibition: Guide students to prepare a suitable area to hang the works they have created for discussion by the whole class
activities.assessment_criteria: Various types of pictures have been accurately designed
suggested_resources: Drawing tools and various texts on drawing techniques

activities.learning_activity: Modelling and decorating various shapes
suggested_methods: Discussion: Guide students to discuss the characteristics of suitable clay, clay preparation, tools, and techniques used in modelling
Demonstration: Guide students by showing the correct way to model and decorate various shapes
Exhibition: Guide students to arrange works of art for discussion and further learning
activities.assessment_criteria: Various shapes have been accurately modelled and decorated
suggested_resources: liquid glue and various texts on pottery

activities.learning_activity: Using materials to make objects with simple shapes
suggested_methods: Discussion: Guide a discussion on how to prepare materials, tools, and various techniques for making objects with different shapes
activities.assessment_criteria: Objects with simple shapes have been accurately made using materials

activities.learning_activity: Performing exercises to build strength and speed
suggested_methods: Drills: Guide students in groups to perform exercises to build strength and speed
activities.assessment_criteria: Exercises to build strength and speed have been performed correctly
suggested_resources: Exercise equipment (cones, whistles, hurdles, and ropes)

activities.learning_activity: Tug of war
suggested_methods: Drills: Guide students to play tug of war
activities.assessment_criteria: The tug of war game has been played correctly

activities.learning_activity: Playing football and netball
suggested_methods: Drills: Guide students to play football and netball
activities.assessment_criteria: Football and netball have been played correctly

activities.specific_competence: 1.1 Mastering the basics of singing and acting
activities.learning_activity: (a) Using various acting techniques
suggested_methods: Discussion: Guide students to discuss how singing and acting are conducted in the community
Demonstration: Guide students in groups to prepare a short play with a theme derived from their community. The play should be presented in front of the class
activities.assessment_criteria: Various acting techniques have been used correctly

activities.specific_competence: 1.1 Mastering the basics of singing and acting
activities.learning_activity: (b) Dancing traditional dances
suggested_methods: Discussion: Guide students to discuss various types of local dances and how they are performed
Demonstration: Guide students in groups to prepare and perform a dance. The dance should carry any message from the respective community and be performed in front of all students at school
activities.assessment_criteria: Various dance techniques have been used correctly

activities.learning_activity: Drawing pictures by observing various objects
suggested_methods: Discussion: Guide students to discuss the basic principles to consider when drawing pictures by observing various real objects and shapes
Practical demonstration: Guide students to show correct ways of using drawing materials and techniques for drawing pictures of real objects through observation.
Demonstration: Guide students to arrange works of art for discussion to learn more
activities.assessment_criteria: Pictures have been drawn correctly by observing various objects
suggested_resources: various shapes and texts related to drawing

activities.learning_activity: Performing endurance exercises
suggested_methods: Drills: Guide students to perform endurance exercises
activities.assessment_criteria: Endurance exercises have been performed correctly

activities.learning_activity: Playing high and low jumping games
suggested_methods: Drills: Guide students to play high and low jumping games
activities.assessment_criteria: High and low jumping games have been played correctly

activities.learning_activity: Playing running games
suggested_methods: Drills: Guide students to play running games
activities.assessment_criteria: Running games have been played correctly
